notes: PiSensor system bench: Raspberry Pi 5 `soakee` (ssh host `pi`, 192.168.10.2) -TCP-> test/int/bench/tcp_bridge.py on the workstation (192.168.10.1, port 50000; the image is the TCP client and is started with `-a 192.168.10.1 -p 50000`) -> fprime-yamcs (HTTP 8190, instance fprime-project). Run fth from the campaign root on the workstation: `uut` is the checkout of this repository, `yamcs-config` the YAMCS configuration directory of ground/README.md, `inputs` holds the image and its dictionary; python3 (yamcs-client, requests) and fprime-yamcs are on PATH. The unit has no debugger: flash copies the image over ssh and starts it, and the serial is the Pi serial number of /proc/cpuinfo. Image, ground system and sender are those of test/int/bench/yamcs_bench.py; the recorder is test/int/bench/yamcs_recorder.py (ground reception time, CFDP transfers, frames, received files); the actions are test/int/bench/uut.py.
